hook: Milchanowski built her career at the intersection of AI and financial crime, from model risk management at JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley to leading a global AI and quantum lab at EY that supported the U.S. National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence, before becoming BMO's first Chief AI and Quantum Officer and founding director of its applied AI institute.
name: Kristin Milchanowski

quote.text: I am honored to serve as Chief AI & Quantum Officer of BMO Financial Group and the founding Director of the BMO Institute of Applied AI & Quantum.
quote.context: Kristin Milchanowski, PhD, personal LinkedIn profile summary
